answer: Each newcomer needs three havens, each locking base yarrow it has held untouched for one full horizon. A haven may stake one lineage member per horizon, and once it does the two are linked forever: an operator's second clone can use neither its three havens nor any haven they touched. Clone k therefore needs three fresh havens whose aged yarrow the operator cannot buy — payment counts as touching and restarts the horizon. Every head adds three recruits and their frozen stakes; a newcomer still pays just one first stake.
